title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 2 — Guarded / Constrained EMA v1 Development Smoke Protocol
research_question: Can fixed alpha=0.5 EMA remain the default stabilizer while a parameter-free, minimum-distance projection is applied only when its current placement excludes the frozen primary-subject center, thereby retaining more TS-1 temporal benefit than TS-2 while recovering TS-1 strong-motion spatial loss?

amendment1_smoke.mechanism: Motion-adaptive alpha repaired spatial lag by weakening or disabling smoothing on large-motion transitions, structurally sacrificing the temporal benefit the amendment was intended to preserve.

scientific_variables.ts0: Stage 5.3 FINAL FROZEN CMP-1; no temporal smoothing
scientific_variables.ts2: motion_adaptive_ema_v1; retained unchanged as an ablation reference
scientific_variables.ts3: guarded_constrained_ema_v1; fixed TS-1 EMA proposal plus current-frame center-containment projection
scientific_variables.only_changed_variable: Post-EMA placement projection is added to TS-1; EMA alpha, state update, reset policy, input signal, crop dimensions, and all frozen composition semantics remain unchanged.
unchanged: sanitized frozen primary subject and bbox
fixed EMA alpha=0.5 and unconstrained EMA state
crop width, derived crop height, and target ratio

guard_inputs: frozen crop width and derived crop height

guard_constraint.definition: For every non-fallback frame, the current frozen primary-subject center must lie inside the final half-open crop rectangle [x,x+Cw) × [y,y+Ch).
guard_constraint.symbols: W,H are frame dimensions; Cw is frozen crop width; Ch is the existing target-ratio-derived crop height; px,py are exact current frozen subject-center coordinates.

projection_rule.proposal_domain: The existing TS-1 final integer top-left placement after its unchanged floor/frame clamp.
projection_rule.minimum_correction: Coordinatewise clipping is the nearest point in the closed safe integer rectangle under both Euclidean and L1 distance; a safe proposal is unchanged and an unsafe proposal moves only to the nearest violated boundary.
projection_rule.state_feedback: The corrected placement is output-only. It is never fed back into the fixed-EMA state, so future EMA proposals remain exactly TS-1 proposals.
projection_rule.not_a_snap: Projection does not return the raw CMP-1 center unless that point independently equals the nearest safe boundary.
projection_rule.fallback: No guard is evaluated on fallback frames; frozen center-crop placement and state clearing are inherited exactly.

reset_semantics.NEW_VIDEO: State never crosses video_id; the first valid frame initializes from its own raw center.
reset_semantics.FRAME_GAP_GT_1: A frozen frame-id gap greater than 1 resets before the current frame.
reset_semantics.FALLBACK: A fallback frame emits the frozen center crop and clears state; the next valid frame reinitializes.
reset_semantics.scene_or_shot_reset: NONE; no new reset is introduced.

smoke.selection: Reuse the exact existing model-blind Smoke24 for matched TS-0/TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 comparison; no reselection or deletion.

coverage_audit.conclusion: The frozen manifest includes strong-off-center frames that exposed TS-1 lag and supports a strict matched mechanism comparison.

amendment2_mechanism_checks: Every non-fallback TS-3 crop contains the current frozen primary-subject center.
TS-3 strong-off-center visible-fraction delta versus TS-0 is strictly better than TS-1 on the same Smoke frames.
TS-3 mean displacement, mean acceleration, and >0.20 jump ratio are each no worse than TS-2 on the same Smoke frames.
decision_rule.promotion_rule: Only if every engineering gate, every unchanged Stage 5.4 scientific gate applied to TS-3 versus TS-0, and every Amendment 2 mechanism check passes may TS-3 be proposed for a later Formal preregistration. Smoke never freezes TS-3.
decision_rule.failure_rule: Any failure stops promotion. Do not alter the constraint, projection, gates, manifest, or exclusions after seeing Smoke; another mechanism requires a new protocol.

all_must_pass: all treatment crop sizes and targetRatioWH unchanged
TS-0 frozen CMP-1, TS-1, and TS-2 regressions=0
protocol/config snapshots and artifact manifest generated

runtime.resume: Same immutable identity plus --resume; completed per-video shards are reused.
runtime.output_collision: A non-resume start refuses an existing output identity; no overwrite, reset, clean, or automatic deletion.

determinism: Pure CPU arithmetic over SHA-frozen inputs; an in-process replay must produce the same canonical record SHA.
formal_freeze_procedure: After Smoke, a human reviews matched raw evidence. Only a passing candidate may enter a separate later PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FORMAL preparation round before any Dev166 TS-3 execution. This DRAFT is not a Formal preregistration.
limitations: The frozen primary bbox is detector output, not composition GT.
Center containment is a deliberately minimal safety constraint and does not guarantee full-bbox containment or visible fraction >=0.90.
Visible-fraction and multi-subject measures remain diagnostics and unchanged gates, not inputs to TS-3.
Smoke24 is a development subset and cannot establish Heldout or official-test generalization.
references: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
